Comment: Fetches an XML invoice document from the fake data API. Non-JSON responses arrive wrapped as $.body; validates that wrapping.

FetchInvoices.Comment: GET /api/fake/xml/invoices?count=5&seed=7 - XML document, arrives as $.body string.

ValidateXml.Comment: Non-JSON response must be wrapped as a string body.

ValidationFailed.Cause: XML response was not wrapped as a string body
